title: Dual-Venue leg spec
description: A leg is defined ONCE and run by each venue whenever it is free (P1). legSpecSha256 in a receipt is the sha256 of this file's exact bytes, so editing a leg makes a new subject.

card.description: The card that declares this leg; venues.json roles are keyed by it.

clipId.description: A CONSENTED CLIP ID (never a path, never a tracked fixture: the fixtures are 2 and 16 frames and can never satisfy the owner's 20 s of real footage, so a fixture id is refused by the runner's admission gate, typed, and cannot even be written in a tracked leg). The runner also refuses a venue that has no owner-typed record for this id in venue-clip-consent.json.

playSeconds.description: The settled-playback window the job plays (generator -PlaySeconds). The owner's floor is 20 s; the clip must cover it and the run must advance that many distinct source frames, or the receipt is INVALID.

backends.description: Every playback leg runs as cuda AND cpu on EVERY venue (Amendment 1 A1). 'gl' is reserved and not yet runnable.

scaleFactor.description: The playback scale the leg REQUESTS. The receipt also records the scale the app actually rendered at (effectiveScale, read from the app's own run log); a leg whose run rendered at any other scale than the accepted one ends SCALE_NOT_HONOURED, never PASS.

displayMode.description: OPTIONAL (DUAL-VENUE-DISPLAY-MATRIX-1). The display mode the leg REQUESTS: 'fullscreen' (the default when the field is absent, so every existing leg is unchanged) or 'windowed' (the app's own --windowed: a normal maximized window with chrome). The receipt's display block carries the requested AND the observed mode (read from the app's own gui_smoke.window_placement line) and the window it presented in. FAIL CLOSED: a leg that ran in a different mode than it names (a requested-windowed leg that ran full screen), or that names a mode the run log cannot confirm, ends INVALID (DISPLAY_MODE_NOT_HONOURED), never PASS or FAIL.

acceptedEffectiveScale.description: OPTIONAL, per backend: the scale that backend is KNOWN to render at when it is not scaleFactor (the CUDA texture route clamps every requested scale other than 1 to 1: MainWindowGpuPreviewPolicy.h). A run that renders at exactly this scale passes with the receipt verdict DECLARED_CLAMP and both numbers in its outcomeDetail; any other rendered scale is SCALE_NOT_HONOURED. A leg that wants its requested scale on a backend declares nothing and lists no backend that cannot render it.

forceLookAssist.description: SPEED legs only (PLAYBACK-BACHELOR-PRESENT-JITTER-1): force Look Assist on WITHOUT a contact sheet (generator -ForceLookAssist -LookPaceLeg), so no GUI-thread framebuffer grab lands inside the timed Play. A look leg ignores it (its look block forces Look Assist).

lookFlavor.description: With forceLookAssist on a SPEED leg: the Look Assist flavor (generator -LookFlavor).

playbackRenderLookaheadFrames.description: With forceLookAssist on a SPEED leg: the playback render lookahead depth the app runs at (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_RENDER_LOOKAHEAD_FRAMES; generator -PlaybackRenderLookaheadFrames). Absent: the app's default.

swapInterval.description: PLAYBACK-VSYNC-DEFAULT-1: the GL swap interval every playback surface requests (MLVAPP_SWAP_INTERVAL; generator -SwapInterval), any leg type. 1 = vsync. Absent: nothing is set and the app keeps its default (1: the VSync setting, which an automation run reads fresh), so the job is the text it was before.

rawPrefetchDecoders.description: PLAYBACK-LJ92-DECODE-THROUGHPUT-1: the raw-uint16 prefetch decoder count the app runs at (generator -RawPrefetchDecoders). 0 = MLVAPP_DISABLE_RAW_UINT16_PREFETCH=1 (no prefetch); 1..4 = MLVAPP_RAW_UINT16_PREFETCH_DECODERS=<k>. Absent: the app's default (2). Any leg.

generatorArgs.description: Generator arguments other than -Venue/-Backend/-ScaleFactor/-SourceCommit/-BuildManifestSha256/-ClipId (the runner sets those).

receipt.description: OPTIONAL (LOOK-ASSIST-FILM-FLAVOR-2 r2): a receipt file relative to tools/profiling/dual-venue/. The GUI smoke applies it before playback (--receipt). The runner reads it as COMMITTED at the admission head, never from the working copy. A measurement instrument (for example AgX off, so a capture can be re-graded frame-locked), not a product setting.

receiptSha256.description: sha256 of the committed receipt bytes. legSpecSha256 binds this hash, and so the receipt's bytes; a mismatch refuses the leg (LOOK_RECEIPT_UNBOUND).

look.description: Required when legType is 'look'. Look Assist is FORCED on for a look leg (Amendment 1 A2).

criteria.description: Per venue ROLE (P3) and per backend: criteria evaluated against the metrics copied verbatim from summary.json. An empty list is informational (no gating).
